title: San Pedro Apartment Building – 3 Lots
summary: Three adjoining lots in San Pedro with a three-storey building designed for six one-bedroom apartments. The two third-floor apartments are finished and fully furnished; the ground and second floors are at grey-work stage.
descriptionHtml:
An exceptional investment opportunity in San Pedro: three adjoining lots and a three-storey apartment building designed for six one-bedroom apartments, with room to expand.

Property & land

  • Lot 1 – 1,456: 358.7 sq. yd.
  • Lot 2 – 1,457: 392.9 sq. yd.
  • Lot 3 – 1,458: 389.4 sq. yd.
  • Building: approximately 7,078.5 sq. ft.
  • Each floor: approximately 1,395.5 sq. ft. (71′6″ × 33′)

Each floor was designed for two one-bedroom, one-bathroom apartments, each with a kitchen and living area.

Third floor – fully furnished

The two third-floor apartments are finished and furnished, ready for occupancy or rental income. Each has central air conditioning, a stove and refrigerator, a kitchen island and sink, basic kitchen utensils and cookware, a washer and dryer, a TV and sofa, a bed and built-in closet, a ceiling fan, and a shower, WC and wash basin.

Ground & second floors

The ground and second floors are at grey-work stage, so the buyer can complete the four remaining apartments to their own finishes and specifications.

Why invest

  • Prime San Pedro location on three adjoining lots
  • Six-apartment design, two apartments already complete and furnished
  • Four more apartments to finish to your own specification
  • Built to take a 4th floor, with provision for an elevator
  • Strong rental and income potential, for residential or investment use

Serious inquiries only. Viewings by appointment.
